cell: logical 1x1x1 on 0.55 m grid; mount = Socket_Mount_Bottom

R4W_EmpEmitter_ROOT.style: R41_Turret_v6.1 standard (heavy industrial armour + team colour)

Socket_Mount_Bottom.role: mounting face centre, normal -Y, connects to cell (0,-1,0)

R4W_EmpEmitter_Yaw.role: Yaw: rotate around local Y only (turns the LOS sensor; the pulse itself is radial)

R4W_EmpEmitter_ChargeRing_Lower.role: lower charge ring: rotates about local Y, slides up when charging

R4W_EmpEmitter_ChargeRing_Upper.role: upper charge ring: counter-rotates, slides down when charging

R4W_EmpEmitter_Antenna_1.role: antenna: tilts outward about its local X hinge on Charge/Discharge

R4W_EmpEmitter_Antenna_2.role: antenna: tilts outward about its local X hinge on Charge/Discharge

R4W_EmpEmitter_Antenna_3.role: antenna: tilts outward about its local X hinge on Charge/Discharge

R4W_EmpEmitter_Antenna_4.role: antenna: tilts outward about its local X hinge on Charge/Discharge

EMP_PulseRing.role: radial EMP shock ring FX: scale 0.001 idle -> 4.5 on discharge (visual only; game radius 9 m)

EMP_ChargeGlow.role: charge glow FX between the rings

Muzzle.role: pulse origin above the core; local +Z = up (radial area effect, no projectile)

visible_exits_note: no barrel, no projectile: one radial pulse origin (Muzzle, +Y up)
notes: Pitch intentionally absent: EMP acts radially; Yaw only orients the LOS sensor.
Ring angles at clip ends are multiples of 120 deg (3-fold symmetric pods).
